conditions.gc: No 10-minute wait. Lifecycle finishes before startup 60-second cleanup; old unreferenced content hash is retained for revert.
conditions.readiness: Initialized + isCacheClean + live selected file stat/hash validity + two stable turns; readonly overlapping IDB transaction.done commit barrier and selected stored file records equal live.

limitations: Scope is selected Markdown/attachment cache objects and file bytes, not full MetadataCache runtime DTO or SDK descriptors. Native timestamps/private hash encoding are retained facts; no universal scheduling promise.
Cache clean + stable turns does not alone certify IDB commit. Every snapshot also completes overlapping readonly file/metadata transaction.done and verifies stored selected file records equal live.
Lifecycle finished in about5.4seconds; stale content hashes survived naturally before startup60s/recurring10m cleanup. No forced GC/cache injection/reparse.

A prior safely caught readiness probe failed because fs.mtimeMs was compared without native Math.round; corrected report retained under target/rea/p2-cache/readiness-raw-ms.json. No GUI errors or malformed transport.
